text:
alex: FYI seeing a weird reconnect spike for SSE clients since the cost-saver routing rollout. Clients reconnecting ~1-2x/min and some duplicate tokens billed.

maria: ugh. any console alerts?

alex: console shows a tiny error rate (0.8%) on route X but billing shows token counts up 8%.

jamal: pinging proxy logs now. do we have a repro? which customers affected?

alex: small set of canary tenants only — set A. repro easy with long-lived chat session + idle >30s.

kevin: sounds like our new session-window TTL + sticky-routing interaction. what is the rollout config?

anya: I rolled the routing policy yesterday to 20% canary -> 100% last night after a script patch (oops).

maria: that would explain scope being larger than intended. did console UX show the toggle change?

anya: it did, but the rollout page truncates the decimal percent and showed "20". I had a script that flipped the raw percent and UI applied 100.

jamal: in the proxy tail I see frequent 204s and then clients immediately re-open with resume_id lost. snippet: 
```
[proxy] session: lease_expired grace_period_ms=0 route=cost-saver -> fallback=standard
[proxy] client reconnect: resume_id="" trace=xyz
```

kevin: grace_period_ms=0?? defaults should be 5000. why zero?

alex: that's the weird bit — our session TTL migration added a field `grace_period_ms` in the routing policy proto; older proxies without the field treat missing as 0.

maria: so rollout of new policy to some proxies caused asymmetric behavior: new control plane sets field, old proxies assume 0 -> immediate lease expiry -> reconnect loop?

jamal: exactly. cheaper route marks session as transferable only after grace, but older proxies considered it expired immediately and force-close. Clients try resume -> resume_id is valid but backend rejects because route changed during immediate rebind -> duplicate charge path.

anya: confirmed: canary tenants were hit because their traffic landed on a mixed fleet of proxies (some patched, some not).

console-bot: incident INC-1745 created by @sre-bot for SSE reconnect surge.

sre-bot: paging @oncall-eng-platform. severity: P2.

kevin: action items: 1) revert routing policy to remove grace field from control plane or 2) fast-roll patch to old proxies to treat missing as 5000 ms. preference?

jamal: patching proxies takes ~45m to rollout. revert to prior policy is instant. I'd prefer revert now, then patch with migration plan.

anya: revert done. monitoring -> watching.

alex: thanks. we should also add a console guard to prevent script from flipping raw percent ints -> decimals and show the raw underlying % change in the audit log.

maria: telemetry note: sampling for resume success/failure is at 0.1% in current dashboard. need to bump to 5% for resume_id traces until we finish. right now dashboard undercounts failures.

kevin: agreed. console metrics team, can you add a temporary higher-sample trace for resume_id failures and a tag for "routing-policy-version"?

anya: I'll add an audit event in the rollout path to include the exact protobuf payload so we can query who got the new field.

jamal: small follow-up: add a fallback de-dup token check in billing path — if we see resume attempts within 2s of a 204 and identical trace_id, suppress double-metering. cheap safeguard.

alex: file issue for billing dedupe. priority-high.

console-bot: dashboard alert threshold lowered for SSE reconnect rate to 0.5% (was 1%).

maria: initial telemetry shows reconnects dropping to baseline after revert. billing team to validate cost delta.

kevin: postmortem items: 1) protobuf migration compatibility rule 2) rollout UX: show raw percent and require explicit confirmation for >50% change 3) increase resume_id sampling and route-version tagging 4) billing dedupe mitigation 5) fast proxy compatibility test in canary harness. owners?

anya: I'll own 2 + audit event.

jamal: I'll own 1 + 5 (proxy patch & canary harness).

maria: telemetry and dashboard action -> me.

alex: billing dedupe -> kevin?

kevin: yep I'll file with billing and track.

anya: re: rollout UX — can someone add a short note in the console that rollout percentages are floats and scripts should use the API `rollout.percent` not the UI text field?

maria: good idea. also add a warning when toggling >10% from previous value.

jamal: logging todo: emit route_version and routing_policy_hash on session open so we can map which proxy saw which fields.

alex: ok wrapping. thanks all. :thumbsup:

anya: closing incident once billing confirms no leftover double-charge. will post a short incident note.

sre-bot: incident INC-1745 status -> monitoring.

kevin: postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 in #eng-postmortems.

maria: i'll start an eval checklist to catch similar protobuf additions in the future.

alex: nice. let's avoid this class of mismatch again.
